intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 1  Divide top by bottom — look for repeating remainders
2  If it repeats, use dot notation
3  One dot = single digit repeats; two dots = block repeats
4  To convert back: let x = decimal, multiply, subtract
commonMistakes: 0.333… ≠ 0.3 — it goes on forever; use dot notation 0.3̇
0.166… = 0.16̇ — dot only above the repeating digit(s).
When converting back: multiply by 10ⁿ where n = number of repeating digits.
